result.title: NavDecision: Parallel Multi-Step Action Prediction with Persistent Self-Referential Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
result.summary: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires timely decisions based on instructions and visual observations. However, autoregressive VLN models generate action descriptions token by token, introducing substantial inference overhead. Decision models offer an efficient alternative but face challenges in maintaining short-horizon action coherence and long-horizon goal alignment. To address these challenges, we propose NavDecision, an efficient multi-step VLN decision model. We introduce parallel multi-step action prediction (PMAP) to predict multiple action distributions from a shared vision-language state, and memory-augmented self-referential policy optimization (M-SRPO) to learn from unsuccessful trajectories using successful trajectories as references. A cross-iteration success memory further accumulates historical successful trajectories to provide informative training feedback. NavDecision achieves success rates of 64.60% on R2R-CE and 64.57% on RxR-CE with a 4B backbone. Compared with existing autoregressive VLN methods, it delivers significant inference speedups of up to $22.28\times$ and $18.96\times$ while maintaining comparable navigation performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NavDecision 视觉-语言导航决策模型：用并行多步动作预测从共享的视觉-语言状态一次输出多个动作分布，并以记忆增强的自指策略优化借助成功轨迹参考来利用失败轨迹训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由同一状态并行生成多步输出」可供核查并行 latent 推理中共享状态是否保留必要视觉信息、是否出现信息坍缩；以成功轨迹为参照的失败轨迹训练也可能为轨迹监督与贡献分配提供线索，但任务本身是导航策略而非推理状态研究。
